payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to reduce data sparsity effects in neural machine translation (NMT) systems, including a variant of Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) for word segmentation and a mix-source method utilizing monolingual data.

claims.text: A variant of Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) was proposed to perform effective word segmentation for Vietnamese texts, alleviating the rare-word problem in NMT systems.
The mix-source method allows the integration of monolingual data from the target language into the NMT system, which helps mitigate data sparsity.
